title: Dead End City — airports, aircraft and parachute reserve
introduction: Native, unedited High screenshots of the airport, aircraft, longer flight horizon and J cutaway/reserve changes. Scenes use explicit inspection staging rather than ordinary mission completion. Main and reserve poses receive normal rendered warmup before capture; the audit records inputs and exact source hashes. Earlier vehicle and mission reviews remain linked below.

comparisons.title: Courier: solid exterior
comparisons.description: Corrected surface winding closes the fuselage and its end caps. Same airframe and camera setup; normal HUD and world time can differ.

comparisons.title: Airliner: enclosed body and engines
comparisons.description: Outward-facing fuselage and engine cowls replace see-through surfaces. Fan hubs and recessed internal walls give the inlets depth.

comparisons.title: High flight horizon: 600 m to 3 km
comparisons.description: Matched county approach at 180 m AGL. Merged distant scenery and height-aware haze extend the view while the near-detail radius stays 225 m.

screenshots.title: Southport terminal
screenshots.description: Glazed facades, a layered roof, entrance canopy, control tower and apron stand markings. Native High inspection.

screenshots.title: Oceanview terminal and bridges
screenshots.description: Enclosed boarding bridges cross the road at 5 m, slope toward the aircraft doors and keep support feet outside the carriageway.

screenshots.title: Courier in three dimensions
screenshots.description: Native High chase inspection from the front quarter: enclosed fuselage, cockpit and landing gear.

screenshots.title: Airliner exterior and inlets
screenshots.description: Native High chase inspection shows the closed body and recessed engine internals.

screenshots.title: County from 600 m
screenshots.description: High chase flight uses a 3 km atmospheric horizon with distant scenery merged into simpler geometry.

screenshots.title: Coast and bridges
screenshots.description: High aerial view at 450 m: districts, bridges, terrain and ocean fade into the distance.

screenshots.title: Downtown approach
screenshots.description: A staged 300 m approach north toward the city. High settings use distant merged scenery and height-aware haze.

screenshots.title: Coast at dusk
screenshots.description: High flight at 400 m and 19:00, looking east across the coast. Atmospheric haze follows the directional sky color.

screenshots.title: Main canopy fully open
screenshots.description: A physical J press opens the main. The adjusted chase camera frames the jumper, lines and full canopy together.

screenshots.title: J cuts away the main
screenshots.description: Release J and press it again after opening: the main separates while the jumper keeps the same momentum and returns to freefall.

screenshots.title: J deploys the reserve
screenshots.description: Another release and fresh J press opens the white-and-teal reserve. Each rig carries one reserve; holding the key cannot chain actions.
